rules.admission: unchanged v1 thresholds applied with v2 measurement on BOTH sets: known-truth wrong rate <= 0.001 per set, no image > 0.005, tiers with < 1000 known predictions in a set need 0 wrong there, and every admitted tier needs > 0 known predictions on the exposed set; procedure: start from the v1 base tiers (V, J, PT, FILL) plus IP, drop the worst failing tier and re-measure until all pass (a V failure is STOP: no admitted set); test each other tier alone on top; finally measure the combined admitted set (and JT) on both sets, dropping optional tiers in reverse admission order until the combination passes; JT data is exempt from the exposed known-prediction requirement but must meet the rate tests wherever it has known predictions; a record whose combined set does not pass admits nothing
rules.correction: rates use only predictions against known reference truth; predictions over reference-unknown bytes are reported separately. The exposed set has complete truth, so v1's exposed-set rates are unchanged by the correction; v2's outcome changes come from (a) also requiring the development set (with corrected rates), (b) testing JT data, (c) the enforced three-decoder rule (Capstone dc.w pseudo-ops are not decodes; v1's fallback accepted them)
rules.decoders: CPU-owned decoder AND m68k-disasm AND Capstone on every instruction; CPU must agree with every independent decode and at least one independent decoder must decode
rules.rt: record-table roots (RT) are reported but not admissible: no source-backed precision measurement exists (d07 had no qualifying table)

sets.status: the exposed set influenced v1 rule selection and was re-measured after v1: it is exposed validation, not an independent test; v2 is a measurement correction on already-seen data, disclosed as such

rules.version: v2 (corrected measurement; supersedes v1 for decisions, v1 plan 5a1cd094 and its admission are preserved unchanged)
